summary: All three source gaps survive; F01 is power-loss/filesystem-conditional; F02 gains a same-release repair process-kill reproducer; F03 needs only process death.

attempted_refutations: save backup or import tree sync
results.result: Calls synchronize files, staging root and publication parent only; no nested-tree or newly created ancestor-link sync chain.
results.required_narrowing: Do not describe ordinary application-process death alone as nested-file loss. Exact persistence loss requires power/storage failure and no stronger implicit filesystem guarantee.

refined_reproducer: Have damaged current R with old READY/index intact and a missing declared file, plus unrelated valid game U.
Use repair and its same-release redownload action at HallApp.kt:L347; no active transfer already owns R.
Let replacement .R.staging become VERIFIED at Installation.kt:L73; kill before damaged target is moved at L90.
Restart. VERIFIED && target.exists at L122 picks old damaged target rather than staging; activation check throws.
Journal/staging stay, ready remains false, U is inaccessible, and product retry repeats.
refuted_stronger_claims: A clean complete new-release directory necessarily becomes invalid merely from process death.
results.accepted_scope: Persistent product retry loop until state changes or code is corrected; gated by damaged target/invalid journal candidate.

results.result: Recovery completes row and deletes journal with no root cleanup; all later automatic paths skip or ignore it.
reproducer: Kill after DIRECTORY_PUBLISHED before activation/worker cleanup.
Restart with intact files. Recovery activates/completes row and deletes journal.
Full task archive/index root remains; worker/reconciler skip completed; maintenance and UI cleanup do not delete it.
results.correction_to_author: Completed rows cannot be cleaned by an ordinary cancel; prior-state allowlist excludes completed and UI hides cancel.
